residual_risks: The stdio request helper is deliberately sequential; adding concurrent in-flight requests would attach competing stdout listeners and make response ownership ambiguous.

Startup readiness accepts any stderr buffer beginning with the expected marker and ignores later stderr after readiness, so a diagnostic emitted immediately after the marker is captured but is not independently treated as a test failure.
testing_gaps: No targeted case forces a post-start response timeout and verifies both prompt rejection and child cleanup through the end-to-end test's finally path.

The scenario proves that the configured temporary directory receives the persisted BPMN file, but it does not place a sentinel around the real default diagrams directory; a hypothetical dual-write regression could therefore escape this gate.
